name: Aria Hotel Budapest
positioning: Music-inspired boutique hotel in a restored 19th-century former bank beside St. Stephen's Basilica in Budapest's historic center
best_for: Music and arts lovers who want a themed stay
Travelers who want a walkable base in central Budapest

facts.text: The hotel is in Budapest's historic city center, beside St. Stephen's Basilica.
The hotel is just steps from Budapest's pedestrian shopping and dining streets.
The hotel occupies a restored 19th-century former bank.
The hotel's boutique design is inspired by music.
Rooms in the Classical wing have Neo-Baroque furniture and Murano glass chandeliers.
Bathrooms are lined with onyx and have separate showers and tubs.
The hotel has a pool, spa, fitness center, steam bath, sauna and whirlpool.
A small theater off the lobby hosts intimate performances and screenings.
There is a complimentary wine and cheese reception in the afternoon.
The hotel is a member of the Library Hotel Collection.
Aria Hotel Budapest was ranked the number 6 hotel in Central and Southern Europe in the Condé Nast Traveler Readers' Choice Awards 2026.

highlights.text: Rooms and suites are split into four musically themed towers, jazz, classical, opera and contemporary, and each is named for an artist or composer in that genre.
The lobby-level Music Garden courtyard, topped by a glass roof, is the hub of the hotel.
Evenings in the Music Garden feature live music, with a different musical genre each evening.
The hotel has a year-round rooftop with 360-degree city views.
The underground Harmony Spa has a heated pool, a Jacuzzi, a steam room, and Finnish and infrared saunas.

considerations.text: The High Note SkyBar rooftop welcomes locals and tourists as well as hotel guests.
WhataHotel notes compact room sizes typical of boutique city-center hotels.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing that reflects the hotel's luxury positioning and central location.

sources.title: Condé Nast Traveler: Aria Hotel Budapest by Library Hotel Collection
